g.text: Processing report: what the user would see after upload
Detected type, then the chunking strategy it selects, then a sample page with the chunks outlined
2 or more SOP sections (purpose, scope, procedure)
- section words found: Muc dich, Pham vi, Noi dung
under 64 tokens joins its next sibling
Step table: one row = one chunk
hard cap 512, split at a sentence
LEGAL_ARTICLES: one chunk per "Dieu", never merged
MARKDOWN: heading sections, merge short ones
PROSE: paragraphs packed to the token target
Whole document: 14 chunks, average 188 tokens, largest 301 of 512
Click a chunk: see its section path and the exact text that was embedded
Backend needed (ai-service, read-only, same 404 rule as the content view, FR-25): GET .../versions/{id}/chunks
returns family + signals, the rules applied, and per chunk: kind, sectionPath, charStart/charEnd, page, tokenCount.
The page preview is the canonical Markdown slice from page_index, not a PDF bitmap: chunks carry character offsets, no bounding boxes.
